notes.title: Trick or Treating in Version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Version Update 1.2.0

Patch Highlights
•	New Adventure Map: Qian Shou returns for the ultimate challenge in an adventure through the Otherworld.
•	New Boss Encounter: X’athky the Spider Priestess will appear randomly as a boss encounter in various maps across Corum.
•	New Cards: Over 20 new full art cards will be unlocked automatically after the update!
•	New Skins: Seven new skins and an alternate art celebrating the champion of the grand tournament will be available in the store.
•	Matchmaking Update: New matchmaking settings for Dueling Mode.
•	Clan Feature: Clans are now open to all players.
•	Battle Stage Customization: Players can now freely customize battle stages.
•	Card Balances: Adjustments made to Card Cache cards.
•	Bug Fixes: Various improvements and text enhancements.
________________________________________

New Adventure Map – The Otherworld

Qian Shou returns to Corum to issue her final challenge. Face the Living Legend in The Otherworld, where every card you draft matters and every choice you make creates a unique deck for the fight of your life. This pocket dimension houses the most challenging opponents, equipped with X cards and game-changing mutators that will push you to make bold plays and unique combos for victory. Don’t fear, as a mysterious energy in The Otherworld will grant you extraordinary power and enhance the drops you receive as you traverse its lands. Unveil the mysteries as you delve deep into the abyss.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/6709ca71a82849e342738acf7d8dd1fb5cb0f998.png
________________________________________

New Adventure Boss – X’athky the Spider Priestess

Escape the webs of destiny spun by the Spider Priestess from the northern tribes, where she has woven her domain of arachnids throughout the caverns of death. Her army's tunnels connect different continents across Corum, allowing her passage wherever she desires. Starting this update, X’athky will appear randomly as a boss encounter in Adventure Maps. Be cautious—her deadly legs can pierce the very soul from your body!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/1c9782eb4a411d932dcdc977d3e62fa78c98cda5.jpg
________________________________________

A Gift from Us – 23 Full Art Cards Available Now!

After the update, all players will have access to 23 full art cards across all 11 champions in the game. Enhance your deck with stunning artwork and enjoy your combos even more with a hand full of delight!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/5bb95be29a941602f8aaf2469e9d70d33873a9b0.jpg
________________________________________

New Seasonal Collections Ready in the Shop
With the holiday season approaching, the shop is stocked with new skins and alternate art:

•	Roxxor – Van Gogh: Paint, splash, create! Don't judge a book by its cover. The robust giant of the forests may have large hands and cumbersome movements, but his dexterity rivals that of the masters. Showcase your combos with Roxxor in his new Van Gogh outfit!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/feae33b5f9e0c9cd9211df2ebde5af7addde2529.png

•	Sora – S Pop: Shoot for the stars and aim for the galaxy! Sora dazzles with her spells and wands, while her voice melts hearts with every beat. Take the stage with Sora, the upcoming top idol!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/c7b46ccc275559361bfd3f0c376e219b57445174.png

•	Taj – Undertaker: The cycle of life and death mirrors a journey through the Nile—quiet, peaceful, and solemn. Join Taj on his path of redemption as the undertaker of life.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/aa73c394b5cb6569fb52c64b645d5c2f348c8912.png

•	Enryu – Nidhogg: Be reborn as nature’s judgment against mankind in the spirit of destruction. Rise 
from the flames to abolish greed and restore Mother Nature to its perfection.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/b768cdd252dff23504e5b8b813af697baccc3d1c.png

•	Lee and Redeye – Deathmatch: Capture the essence of Death or Glory in stunning artwork as Lee and Redeye face off in a climactic battle. Collect the dynamic duo in an alternate ink style to complete your collection!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/4f64fba515676c2950421f9a2f284c9a16551078.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/9a6707fdedebd17f2edfdd60c77f4ddce57d620b.png

•	Susan – Artemis: Congratulations to Outer Heaven, the winning clan from last month’s Clan Wars event. Victory shines upon you, and the heavens praise your glory. Susan, embodying the spirit of Artemis, will join your celebration as the top clan of the Arena! Every member of Outer Heaven will receive this skin for free after the update!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/2007a4c4559c535e030fc10422a894863a5aa39f.png
________________________________________
Alternate Art – Force Multiplier (A.T.A.C.R)

Congratulations to Majstor, the top Champion of the world! After numerous hard-fought battles, we celebrate all players who joined the Grand Tournament with an alternate art card of Force Multiplier, the trophy card our champion has chosen. All contenders will receive a code through Discord to unlock this special prize in-game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/760405af24613accaa4eef656d8bf6068d529b12.png
________________________________________
New Matchmaking Settings

New matchmaking options are now available in the options menu, allowing players to control the type of queue they wish to enter for PVP. These settings will override existing conditions and matchmaking rules.
________________________________________
Clans Feature

Clans are back! After this update, all players can create their own clans and gather members into their team. Players can also leave their current clan and join another one if they choose. All controls will remain accessible within the clan leaderboard tab from the top bar.
________________________________________
Battle Stage Customization

A new feature allows players to customize the appearance of the battle stage during combat. Over 10 backgrounds from across the game have been added to the library of selectable battle stages, including some new ones as a special treat.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/9c40add9fbae425372bfbaa6a59915877e2352d9.png
________________________________________
Card Balancing

Lee – Like the Wind and Like the Wind X
The “Like the Wind” mechanic enhances Lee’s flexibility for combos, providing both resources and driver options. However, these benefits weren't always worth the slot in the deck compared to other cards. To make this card more special and enable its use, the action point cost has been removed:
•	Action Point Cost: 1 > 0

Taj – Ethereal Projection and Ethereal Projection X
This powerful card in Taj’s kit gains the most benefits when running a 3-worship deck, translating into significant damage. To balance this, we are reducing the base attack damage by 1:
•	Attack Damage: 7 > 6
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/f813c3a12f708c799142c10465d60cf8b35e503c.jpg
________________________________________
Bug Fixes
•	Fixed a bug that caused perpetual attacks not to discard a card when reacting to a missile at speed 3.
•	Fixed a bug with fast reactions leading to an overflowed discard pile when dazed.
•	Fixed various typos and wording inconsistencies in the card cache.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.8 Patch
notes.notes:
Ver 1.0.7 

Patch Highlights 

 Roxxor Upgrade Cards Balancing
 Bug fixes and Performance Improvements


Character Balancing

Roxxor the Giant 
Roxxor falls behind other champions in his diversity of playstyles with a narrow range of playable upgraded cards. As one of the earlier characters which we designed upgraded cards for, we admittedly started off rather conservatively with the power levels of his cards that can change up the pacing of his strategies. 

Spine Pull X 
This grapple was designed as the fastest but weakest one out of Roxxor’s kit. But as an upgraded card with a high rate of failure, it doesn’t make the cut unless it has more of a set up potential to boost other cards. The added Momentum can make Roxxor’s playstyle faster as it is only for a single action point opening up a more aggressive rate of play. 

Momentum Value : 1  3 

Trunk Whack and Trunk Whack X 
Trunk Whack is an interesting reaction card where it is not designed as your typical answer to your opponents, but instead it is a punishment for forgetting that it exists. The nature of Trunk Whack is to be a sabotaging card where the damage it can deal could potentially be game winning with one big strike. This attribute was probably too hidden with a rather generic damage value so we increased the damage and replaced determined in the upgrade version with a damage boost that can further this mechanic to bigger extremes. 

Trunk Whack 
Damage Value : 5 < 8

Trunk Whack X
Action Point Cost : 1 < 2
Damage Value : 5 < 8 
Removed Card Text : You are granted Determined
New Card Text : The damage of your next attack this turn is increased by 8.

Bug Fixes and Performance Improvements

notes.title: Ver 1.0.6 Patch
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.6 
Patch Highlights 

 Redeye and Ardelean balancing 
 Lifesteal and Fortune Reversal Clarification and Mechanic Updates 
 Various Bug Fixes and changes 


Character Balancing 
Redeye the Werewolf
Redeye has been at the top end of the meta for a long time now and the proprietor of the aggressive pacing that the meta needs to answer in order to stay competitive. Redeye by design is a boom or bust character where he either wins quickly or struggles to recover from bad turns. We’re toning down Howl to limit the amount of damage that can be dished out in a turn and making it easier for the opponent to regain control through reactions to stop the rampaging werewolf.

Howl 
Bloodlust requirement : 1 > 0 
Damage boost value : 2 > 1 
Howl X 
Bloodlust requirement : 1 > 0  

Ardelean the Vampire
We are making several more changes to Ardelean in this balance patch to limit the amount of flexibility his deck has access to. From consistent draws to powerful blood feast effects, the combination creates a very stable experience with the vampire where as long as he gets his resources going, he quickly snowballs to become unstoppable in both offensive and defensive aspects. We are targeting these 3 cards to limit the snowball effect on good turns when he has all the pieces at once. 

Ulterior Motive and Ulterior Motive X 
Bonus Speed Value : 2 > 1 
Primal Thirst and Primal Thirst X 
Bonus Attack Value : 3 > 2 
Death Awakening 
Blood Feast requirement : 4  3 

Nocturnal Hunter X 
We are changing the effect of this card because of the changes to LifeSteal and Fortune Reversal not being affected by the bonuses and limitations of Healing effects. As Ardelean already has many survival options, we opted to change the effect to an offensive tool to help Ardelean land attacks and blood feast generators more reliably. 

Card Text Removed : You are granted Double Heal 
Added Card Text : The damage of your next attack is increased by 3. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/d9d77505954294171d41dbddf0303c53711686a9.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/cb2f60c8af64850a4627b9dea7cc61215c78e1a4.jpg

Lifesteal and Fortune Reversal clarifications
We have updated the keyword text of these two mechanics to clear up confusions and change their interactions with Heal enhancers and limiters. These two mechanics will not be affected by bonus heal effects moving forward nor will they be affected by mechanics that will prohibit them as they are considered a Steal and Recovery. We will be designing and balancing cards under this philosophy moving forward when Ardelean and other champions receive changes. 

Life Steal : At the end of turn, take X lives from your opponent 
Fortune Reversal : You will temporarily lose 5(X) lives to draw X cards. For X turns, you will recover 5 lives at the end of turn. 

Bug Fixes 

 Fixed a bug that causes the splash art in the character selection screen to not reflect the selected skin 
 Fixed a bug that causes the game to crash when perpetual is blocked
 Fixed a bug that disables the flashing function when a missile is intercepted with an attack with daze
 Fixed a bug that causes the discard pile to shuffle incorrectly and become stuck at the top of the screen

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Patch Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.4 Patch Highlights 
•	Character balancing
•	Bug fixes and gameplay optimisation

Character Balancing 

Ardelean the Vampire 
The launch of the dark lord has been an amazing one. Learning from our previous mistakes, we’ve carefully designed the interactions of Blood Feast and Blood Rush to create a new Monster experience. Due to the mechanic, Ardelean is atypical in his playstyle where he has to first collect blood then choose what abilities to upgrade with strategic card ordering. With a high ceiling and potential, we felt we had made certain elements of his set up a bit too easy. The following changes will lower the floor of Ardelean to balance out his potential compared to other champions. 

Vampiric Familiar and Vampyric Familiar X 
Unleashed cards are non-interactable for the opponent and generally balanced as a turn-by-turn win condition where the benefits don’t typically spread to subsequent turns. However, the almost inevitable lifesteal this card applies for just 2 blood feast, essentially sets up Ardelean for the whole game. We are adding in an additional condition for lifesteal to activate to require Ardelean to make more daring and bold plays to set up. 

Vampyric Familiars 
New card text : If you have already dealt damage this turn and you have Blood Feast, consume it and you are granted Lifesteal(1) and Cure. 
Vampyric Familiars X 
New card text : If you have already dealt damage this turn and you have Blood Feast, consume it and you Heal 5 lives, granted Lifesteal(1) and Cure. 

Ulterior Motive X
Similarly, we felt that a powerful mechanic such as lifesteal should be conditional and require timing to play out. 

New card text : If neither you nor your opponent has any cards in play, attack speed is increased by 2 and you are granted Lifesteal(1). 

Breathless Embrace and Breathless Embrace X
We’re tuning down the damage of this card to make it easier to stop and reducing the base amount of blood feast that can be gained.

Attack damage : 7 > 6 

Crimson Mist 
Dodge is the best type of reaction in game and normally its speed value is the major inhibiting factor of it. We’re removing the second tier of speed buff to limit its effectiveness and all rounded capabilities. 

Removed card text : If you have Blood Feast(3), consume it and your reaction speed is increased by 2 instead. 

Tori the Paladin 
Some small changes across cards to balance out the card choice in decks.

Invocation and Invocation X 
Attack damage : 10 > 9
 
Judgement and Judgement X 
Attack damage : 8  6 

Uncontrolled Aggression and Uncontrolled Aggression X
Although niche, when used properly these cards are extremely powerful and perhaps too punishing to opponent’s that relies on smaller cards to set up. 

Uncontrolled Aggression 
Next Damage Boost : 4 > 3 

Uncontrolled Aggression X 
Block Value : 5 > 4 
Next Damage Boost : 4  3 
Attack Damage : 9 > 8 

Enryu the Gargantusaur
Feral Defienace and Feral Defiance X 
Feral Defiance is defined by it’s strong defences capabilities but has been often overlooked due to it’s health restriction. This has made it a dead card in many decks when it is drawn early on. We have added in a Level Up mechanic to the card so it can get stronger and stronger when drawn early on, making it almost the ultimate reaction card in the late game. 

Added Level Up Mechanic to both cards 
Block Value at different levels : 6 – 8 – 10 
Added new card text : You are granted Fortify and Persistence. 
Fortify and Persistence Value at different levels : 1 – 2 – 3

Feral Defiance X 
Remove card text : This card is only playable if you are Enraged or when you have 25 or less health.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/2a96004d4ab487a2fdc7813a129630c66c4f6041.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/744a4ef612ffb97447962bc0aadebf9dfef19692.jpg
Bug Fixes 
-	Resolved a bug that will crash on Spell resolution when a previous match was ended during an opponent’s spell casting. 
-	Resolved a bug that causes the missile animation to continuously loop 
-	Changed Crystal’s Level 24 card achievement to be achievable due to the latest card changes 
-	Fixed a bug in Lee’s Tempo Advantage perk that caused action points to inconsistently add 
-	Fixed a bug which caused Transient Enchantment cards to not work as intended
-	Fixed a bug that caused the Rampant Growth Ally card to not resolve 
-	Readjusted the depth of Map hints in Adventure Mode
-	Improved networking code to prevent crashes with server errors 
-	Fixed a bug that prevented Howling Gale X to increase Arcane Resonance

notes.title: EA 0.2.27 Character Balancing and Performance Update
notes.notes:
EA 0.2.28 

Patch Highlights
 - Performance update improving multiplayer experience and Bug Report Feature
 - Character Balancing

Performance Update 
In this patch we have restructured the way multiplayer saves and syncs between one player and another. This should be a positive improvement to the stability of the overall game as we have discovered the previous savings methods was putting a lot of stress on the networking performance. We are still on the lookout for corner bugs such as desync issues, double text and window freezing which we expect to gradually improve as latest updates are live where we have been retooling many parts of the game to decrease VRAM usage. A new feature we have implemented is a Bug Reporting Button that is found in the options menu and surrender pop up. We would like to ask you and our community to help us to better the game and we would be grateful if our community can help our development by pressing the bug report button and writing a small comment when something unusual/unexpected happens. The function of the button is to send us a detailed log of the battle that we could then read and identify the root cause of the bug that was encountered. We are very thankful for our amazing community, and we will continue to improve Death or Glory with everyone’s help! 
 
Character Balancing 

Lee the Dragon Master
Lee as a character has exceeded our expectations repeatedly. With his explosives combos and action regeneration abilities, Lee can reach many heights within just 2 or 3 turns. This is further enhanced by the nature of being a Warrior where, you start and end every turn with roughly the same resources and power level making Lee very consistent playing both the offense and defence. We are making these changes to both reduce the tempo and consistency of Lee between turns so he is more affected by what the opponent does throughout the battle. 

Leg Sweep
The strong control potential of Knockdown enables Lee to perform OTKs and create huge advantages in one continuous stream of attacks that the opponent cannot react against. With how explosive the control effect already is, the damage boost was making the OTKs even more consistent and often Lee will end up killing without using any “big cards” and just use his regular set ups to do more than enough damage. The damage boost is removed so Lee will have to craft a more detailed hand with specific finishers and resources to OTK his foe. 

Removed Card Text : The damage of your attacks is increased by 1 until the end of the turn. 0

Leg Sweep X
The upgraded version of Leg Sweep provides a major benefit of 1 extra base damage, which effectively made this card unstoppable through blocks, and your opponent had to rely on much more expensive and specific reactions such as dodge or absorptions. With how fast Lee can be and those types of reactions typically being resource hungry, a knockdown that does 8 damage without much of a cost nor condition has pushed Lee’s deck over the curve more than what we would have liked. 

Attack Damage ; 8 > 7 

Tori the Paladin
Tori is the stellar embodiment of an Evangelist. Reach transcendence by gaining devotion by playing defensively to set up three powerful turns of transcendence. At that point, an Evangelist is by design blessed by the gods (the game) giving them an unfair advantage of being able to play cards to their heart’s content. This is only balanced by the fact that Evangelists are extremely restricted before they become gods, and it takes multiple turns for them to do so. But Tori’s ramp cards have made her pray with super speed with consistency, allowing her to skip her weak period after the initial turns 1 and 2 in many of her builds. 

Repent
We decreased the damage of this card to make it more susceptible against Fortify and Windy effects that will now counter this part of Tori’s ramp. 

Attack Damage : 3 > 2 

Sacrifice X 
Removed Card text : Your Devotion is further increased by 1

Reverence X
Pious Value : 3 > 2

Resolute X
Managing to land one Resolute X with the additional damage reduction effect effectively meant it was game over, as pretty much none of your opponent’s attacks can go through anymore as everything will be inside of Tori’s blocking range. Despite the cost and setup required for this card to work, we do not think ‘I win’ effects should come from reaction cards. We made a big nerf to the effect right now and looking to find some way to tune it again in later updates. 

Removed Card Text : Reduce your opponent’s attack damage by the value blocked 
Added card Text : Reduce your opponent’s attack damage by 1
 
A.T.A.C.R
Speed reductions make missiles invincible as they cannot be destroyed unless your attack match speed 3 or above. Although Crippling Volley is not completely dominating the meta, it is a cause for concern for becoming the next ‘can’t touch me’ playstyle for the mech. We are making this card easier to be blocked by reverting the stat buff into the more typical 4 speed stat line.

Attack Damage : 4 > 3 
Added card text : During this turn, their damage is also reduced by 1. 

Taj the Witch Doctor
Yes, we’re improving Taj again. But this time is perhaps the last as we feel this is very close to making Taj competitive into the meta. In the initial design phase of the character, we overvalued the worship abilities and thus reduced a lot of the base cards and skeleton of his deck to try and make him counterable. This resulted in making a lot of cards have either lower stats or have delayed effects, and caused the current issues that Taj faces. Compared to many other champions, he is extremely slow and very reliant on his attacks landing in exceedingly early turns which has made him poor competition in the fast meta. Being a mid to late game character, Taj needs access recovery and decent power scaling that can benefit off increased devotion. 

Wall of Carcass X 
Heal : 3  0 
New Block Value : 7  2 
New Card Text : Reset your health to maximum if your health is 15 or below. You become Exhausted. 

Dark Protection X  
New Devotion Value : 1 > 0 
New Block Value : 7  7

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/d8e28f77bf52aad6156e343638a94aef8272960e.jpg

notes.title: EA 0.2.23 Character Balacing Update
notes.notes:
Patch Highlights 
•	Character Balancing 
•	Stealth Mechanic changes
•	Start and End turn Pass desync bugs resolved

Character Balancing 

Sora the Elemental Sorcerer 
Over the past few weeks, we have been continuously making changes to the mage of the stars to better her chances at making her shine through her different elements. To differentiate her deck archetype from Crystal, we have avoided giving her similar levels of controlling keywords so she can be safe whilst setting up. We want Sora to have the ability to go towards the opposite and have a new fun way of playing the spellslinger class in an aggressive manner with quick and rapid attacks. This balance patch will introduce new mana synergies and attack-based combos that Sora manipulate to create a deck that can function in early turns. 

Strong Breeze
Reduced Attack Speed increase : 2 > 1  
Added card text : The Mana cost of cards played this turn is reduced by 1 

Strong Breeze X
Attack Speed : 4  1  
Added card text : The Mana cost of cards played this turn is reduced by 1 

Fire Bolt X 
Removed Card Text : If the Ignite value on your opponent is 2 or above, this attack becomes Perpetual. 
Added card Text : The damage of this attack is increased by the Ignite value on your opponent. 

Engulfing Hand X
Removed Card Text : You are granted Invisibility
Added Card Text : Reduce your opponent’s attack damage by 4 until the end of turn. 

Crystal the Ice Faerie 
We are reworking the mechanics of this card to create balancing valve’s for us to tune Winter’s Embrace moving forward. 

Winter’s Embrace
Mana Cost : 3  3 
Removed Card Text : If your health is lower than your opponent, it is increased by 2X. 
New Card Text : If your health is 15 or below, it is increased by 2X. 

Stealth mechanic balancing 
Stealth as an effect is crucial to certain character’s survivability, but as it stands the randomness and consistency of it when combed with other defensive abilities, makes going up against Susan a terrible experience. We are reworking Stealth to be, in general, a 1 turn benefit to allow players to more effectively play around these strategies and require a turn-by-turn reapplication if the user wants to sustain the full effect. 

Old behaviour : While you are in stealth, any attack damage misses 60% of the time. If you attack, counter or play a missile, miss chance is dropped to 30%. Any damage taken removes stealth.

New behaviour : While you are in stealth, any attack damage misses 60% of the time. If you attack, counter, play a missile or at the end of turn, miss chance is dropped to 30%. Any damage taken removes stealth.

notes.title: EA 0.2.19 Character Balacing Update
notes.notes:
EA 0.2.20
Patch Highlights 
•	Character Balancing : Redeye defences get dampened and Sora buffs to Ignite and Barrier playstyles

Character Balancing 

Sora the Elemental Sorcerer 
This patch mainly focuses on a large revamp to Sora’s overall strength in both setup speed and survivability. Up against aggressive decks, early game Sora barely stands a chance with thin barriers and mana heavy spells that can be easily destroyed by other classes. We are increasing her overall barrier gains and survivability options by giving her access to Double Heal and the capabilities of increasing her Maximum Barrier. We have also decreased the activation cost of several of Ignite cards to push forward her damage potential to start around mid game rather than late game which is more fitting of her fiery passion.

Astral Rain and Astral Rain X 
We replaced the draw capability of this card with Heal to increase the survivability of Sora in the early game where she will most likely need to lose some health in order to bait out resources for a safe spell casting. Sora already has an extremely potent draw engine in the midgame with Enduring Renewal which counteracts this change and allows both cards to serve different functions. 

Card text removed : Draw a card 
New card text : Heal(4) lives

Fire Bolt and Fire Bolt X
With the redesign of Tsunami, the practicality of using Fire Bolt is further diminished due to how easy it is to block the card. A small damage buff was implemented to make the attack playstyle more viable. 

Attack damage : 4  2 
New Spell Damage :5/6 > 3 
Raging Inferno New Card Text : Apply Ignite(3) to your opponent. If your Windy is active, apply Ignite(5) instead. 
Raging Inferno X New Card Text : You are granted Windy(1) and apply Ignite(3). If your Windy is active, apply Ignite(6) instead. 

Tsunami and Tsunami X 
To support Sora’s survivability, we have decided to allow Sora to be the first character in game to increase the maximum barrier value. This will allow Sora to gain benefits through Tsunami from the early game and present a different path to support her other effects rather than relying purely on reactions. 

Mana Cost : 5 > 4 
Added card text : Increase your Maximum Barrier value by 1. 

Violent Tornado
From the playtesting since the release of Sora, we have noticed that Windy has been the weakest part of Sora’s deck. On paper, Windy can be extremely powerful, coupled with Sora being able to increase her attack speed, she can quickly lock opponents out from attacking or blocking. But this has mainly been just a dream, as she wouldn’t have enough time to do all of those things within the multiplayer meta. We are increasing the synergised benefits from Violent Tornado to open up more strategies that can revolve around her wind magic. 

Increased Barrier Value : 2X  1 
Windy Value : 2 > 1 
Added card text : Increase your Arcane Resonance by 1. 

Howling Gale X 
In addition, we have added in an Ignite synergy for the upgraded version to allow another way of speeding up Sora’s offensive capabilities. 

Mana Cost : 2 > 1 
Windy Value : 2 > 1 
Added card text : Increase your Arcane Resonance by 1 and double the value of Ignite on your opponent. 

Enduring Renewal 
Increased Barrier value : 5 < 6 

Sudden Squall X 
Sora doesn’t seem to be able to take advantage of Steroid as many of her playstyles doesn’t rely on attacks. We substituted the ability with Windy to better fit her overall playstyle. 

Removed Card Text : Removed Steroid 
Added Card Text : You are granted Windy(1)

Redeye the Werewolf 
The big bad wolf right now is a very strong champion, with huge damage potential and great counters to a lot of other strategies. Monsters are designed to be aggressive and highly dependent on bloodlust which requires damage being done to the opponent through high stat attack cards. This is something we do not want to touch as it is pivotal and key to the monster playstyle. However, monsters on the other hand should not have access to multiple dominating defense cards that can completely prohibit the opposing set up. We are tuning down the defense package of Redeye and maintaining his offensive potential to give a chance to other characters in the meta. 

Ignore Pain 
Cure was removed to give some vulnerability to Redeye from other characters that can be easily countered from Cure. 

Removed Card Text : You are Cured

Ignore Pain X 
We are retaining Cure for Redeye in the form of this upgraded card but at the same time we are reverting the Bloodlust reduction. A 7/3 block that can be played turn 1 and without restriction or setup is too all rounded for an aggressive deck like Redeye. 

Bloodlust requirement : 0 < 1 

Dice and Dice X 
Having access to two Interrupt cards and the ability to Unleash makes playing spells against Redeye almost impossible. We are removing Interrupt from Dice to give spells a chance when Redeye has poor card flow. 

Removed Card Text : This attack can Interrupt spell casting. 

Leap Aside X 
Similar to Ignore Pain X, we are removing the reduction of Bloodlust to balance out the advantageous and weaknesses of Redeye. 

Bloodlust requirement : 1 < 2 
Attack speed bonus : 1 < 2

Sora the Elemental Sorcerer
Sora is the latest champion introduced to Death or Glory. As the fire mage and most offensive spellcaster in the game, she acts as a countermeasure towards defensive heavy and control decks as spells cant be destroyed unless your opponent attacks. However, Sora currently struggles with turn 1 and turn 2 of the game with mediocre but mana heavy blocks, it is often very easy to deny Sora from her set up by just not playing cards. We made adjustments to her early game defensive package to make her mana build more flexible and card efficient so that her mid to late game can realistically happen. 

Tsunami and Tsunami X 
We have redesigned this card to synergise with all other barriers as both an enabler to them and as a defensive tool for Sora in the midgame. This new ability also fits the name and story of the card a bit more.

notes.title: EA 0.2.5 Character Balancing and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
EA 0.2.5

Patch Highlights
•	Character Balancing, Roxxor and various upgraded cards balancing 
•	Deck save, Card unlock bug fixes 

Character Balancing 
Roxxor the Giant
Roxxor has been struggling to compete with his fellow champions that have more flexibility and response opportunities. Roxxor is designed to be strong and sturdy but he is currently easily shut down by smaller attacks that bring control or prevent him from playing the two big cards he wants to every turn. We have decided to add Persistence to Roxxor’s kit as a staple to establish a clear identity for the big giant as an unmovable tank. 

Home Defend and Home Defend X 
Added New Card Text : You are granted Persistence(4). 
Boulder Stop and Boulder Stop X
Added New Card Text : You are granted Persistence(3). 
Bull Halt and Bull Halt X
Added New Card Text : You are granted Persistence(3).

Crystal the Ice Faerie 
Pinprick has proven to be a staple in Crystal’s deck as it is a cheap and almost certain Freeze application due to it’s piercing capabilities. We increased the requirement for the card to attack with Piercing to allow more time for the opponent to counter Crystal’s set up before she starts her chilly nightmares

Pinprick and Pinprick X
Card Text Change : This attack is Piercing and cannot be blocked, if your Arcane Resonance is 1 or greater > if your Arcane Resonance is 2 or greater

Redeye - Tori - A.T.A.C.R 
During the course of our development throughout Early Access we will be continuously balancing out Upgraded cards and mechanics to hopefully reach a competitive, fun and interesting meta where all characters can shine and have their unique playstyles. 

Repent X 
This card allowed Tori to ramp without a cost way to effectively and efficiently, making it hard for the opponent to react when Tori has a good starting hand. This change will hopefully making Tori’s ramp more strategically planned and less flexible to be played in any situation. 

New Card Text : You are granted a Blessing and your Devotion is further increased by 2. If you have not Transcended you need to discard a card. Otherwise, draw a card. 

Kinetic Barrier and Kinetic Barrier X
After several nerfs to the A.T.A.C.R and the introduction of new characters, the strength of the mech has dwindled a bit and at times have a hard time playing out combos if it is controlled and unable to reload. Since it originally did not have any counter methods to resolve controls and afflictions, we’ve decided to add Persistence to it’s deck. 

Kinetic Barrier and Kinetic Barrier X 
Added New Card Text : You are granted Persistence(3)

Angry Swipe X 
This card has been redesigned as admittedly it was unplayable in both Adventure mode and Dueling Mode. The redesigned ability will retain the same identify of its normal version as a powerful damage connector that allows Redeye to build bloodlust with a boost. 

New Card Text : If you have taken damage this turn, the damage of this attack is increased by 5 and your Bloodlust is increased by 1. You are Exhausted after you attack. 

Ignore Pain X 
Fortify is extremely powerful in PVP as it will potentially make all of the opposing attacks nullified from any form of reaction. As many setup cards are lighter in damage, with Ignore Pain losing it’s bloodlust requirement, Redeye can effectively shut down a large majority of his opponent’s resource building and combo enablers starting turn one. We have decided to tone down the advantage Redeye gains from Ignore Pain X to last only on the turn it is played.

Card Value Change : Fortify (3) > Fortify (1)

Bug Fixes 
•	Discord Reward Verification bug fixed 
•	Reminder Text bug fixed to prevent crashing upon playing certain characters 
•	Fixed a bug in the Deck saving logic that caused all decks to be reset upon relaunching of the game 
•	Fixed various bugs regarding cards being unlocked prior to completing their requirements 
•	Fixed a bug that caused the card image in the progression system to display incorrectly 
•	Adjusted several card challenge requirements 
•	Fixed several faulty achievement counters that prohibited advancements in some levels 
•	Fixed a bug that caused the unlocked Alt-Art to display the wrong card name

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE! Dueling Mode and more heads Death or Glory into a new beginning!
notes.notes:
Champions! 

The wait is over, we are back and ready to start a new development journey with Death or Glory. During the past 3 months, we have been quietly developing the next iteration of Death or Glory that you will be seeing in this update. Lessons we have learned from launch has fuelled our inspirations towards the progression, the unlocks and the game direction we want to take Death or Glory in the upcoming road to the official launch. Admittedly we are aware of our shortcomings and the disappointment we have left our audience in our initial EA launch. This update is our first step into our response to the feedback and reflection that was left by our amazing community. Once again, we want to thank you all for your patience and support into our project and the game we love. 

Major Directions 
•	Dueling Mode - A fast paced and thrilling arena for a variety of duels and battles
•	Progression - a journey of champions and a challenge worthy of a master 
•	Gameplay - depth and variety from a kaleidoscope of decks
•	Aspect Ratio and UI overhaul 

Dueling Mode 
This new mode will be the new main arena for quick fights in Death or Glory against both AI controlled opponents and other players across the world. Designed to be rapid and ever changing, Dueling Mode is over all quite simple in its structure but deep in how many decks can be built. We are introducing the inclusion of upgraded cards into a multiplayer setting with a twist from adventure mode, you are only allowed to bring 2 upgraded cards into battle. 

Building a Regen deck with Strength X, or focusing on an explosive turn with Equality X will be two completely different takes on the win conditions for Tori. Or how about building a ramp deck for Redeye with Bloodboil X and combo it off with an early Ravenous Chomp X to leech and suck all the life out of your opponent. This is just the tip of the iceberg as to what can be explored with over 180 new cards available in multiplayer. Experiment, discover and most importantly enjoy all the crazy strategies and combos that can be born out of the new dueling experience. But this is not all that is new.

Dueling Mode takes place in the tower of duels, a tower built and erected by great alchemists from a bygone era. Every character will journey through the 8 floors in the tower to reach the top. Accumulate score from each battle won and earn bonuses by maintaining winstreaks to blitz through floors. Every character will start from the Beginner Floors and rank up into Expert and Veteran levels where more cards and different decks can be built. As we continue developing throughout the coming months, we will reveal more about the history and details about this monumental arena as the journey continues. 

Check out the rules and some screenshots of Dueling mode down below! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/ed0c5b1c8bbe15d0b0e1b7f6f247b93f5a3a8505.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/0d8089b4a25870d249b40d4086e99a1b75f05051.png
Character Progression
A major focus of this update is an overhaul of each character’s journey in every player hands. We wanted to make every step of the experience with a new character pleasurable, whether it’s when you are new to them, or you struggle through challenging bosses or even when you are dominating game after game, your champion will grow along with your expertise. The new progression track for each champion will introduce 22 more cards to unlock with a variety of fun and interesting targets ranging from just levelling up or playing interesting combos to deal super high damage. Unlock cards, perks, and cosmetics just by dueling and going on adventures. 

The current update will feature integrated progression throughout dueling and the next stage of development will focus on implementing that in adventure mode. Stay tuned for our updates in the second quarter of 2024!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/1de8043318c59b08c24d9d66ddffdc1915866cc0.jpg
Taj - the Witch Doctor

Born into servitude and tormented for his smaller stature, Taj sought vengeance when he failed to protect his beloved. Desperate, he bargained with the gods for strength. But their help came at a price. As his power grew, so did his formidable foes. With every step, blood and soul became his currency, paying the toll for his ascent. Taj's journey unfolds amidst sacrifices, as he battles to overcome his past and claim his rightful place.

Enter the duel as Taj, the next playable Evangelist in Death or Glory. Gain the blessings of the Malevolent Trinity and control the powers of the Spirits, the Serpents, and the Swarm to dominate the arena. With three unique Worship abilities, Taj has very distinct build around cards that can shift his battle style into multiple directions. Control with the Spirit, damage with the Snakes and Swarm with the Crows. The power of the trinity makes Taj nigh unstoppable if he can set up multiple worships in quick succession as he has a strong balance of both control and damage! Explore his decks and expanded possibilities with his upgraded cards in dueling mode today!

*Founders and Early Access Pass owners will automatically unlock Taj, the Witch Doctor as a playable character in both dueling and adventure mode. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/884fefa9eea0c40726f747a0ec9308f24bbfb1fc.jpg
Game Balancing 

Health and Draw 
A small but impactful change we are making in dueling is the initial draw size and health of every champion. Both players will now start with a Maximum of 40 health and draw 6 cards at the beginning of the game. This was changed after we were play testing and decided that this will benefit will balance both aggressive and late game characters by decreasing the luck of the draw on the first turn. We are eager to explore more deeply into this change will likely make adjustments as the season progresses. Please let us know what you think and how the battles feel after the change. 

Cards 
As we are now opening up Upgraded cards to the multiplayer environment, we have made balance changes to several cards we felt was way too strong and hard to deal with. This round of balancing focused on the clear overperformers and admittedly there could be more subtle combos within the game that we have not discovered yet. We will be balancing the game very frequently moving forward, where we expect to change overperforming and underperforming cards every or other week. Explore discover super combos and have fun!

Doom 
We’ve adjusted Doom to be less frustrating to deal with when it is applied early in the game through the luck of the draw. To balance out the ability we adjusted the countdown value on cards. 
Doom New Ability: A doom counter is reduced by 1 at the end of every turn. When it reaches 0, your opponent will suffer damage equal to their life total, if it is 15 or less. Lower doom value replaces higher one.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/4d97f6c884684a3ece174d5f0a2a60e535e8e658.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/c19617e4ec4442d43a1bf7b2af53f27bb7a287a8.jpg
Future of Death or Glory 

Client Upgrades
As you can tell from the new client, one huge difference we are making is to shift the aspect ratio of the game into 16:9. Yes, that was a mistake on our part as we started out development for tablets then transitioned into releasing on PC first. In the following months we will be transitioning the rest of the game into 16:9, most notably the Battle Page and Adventure mode. 

Adventure Mode
Other than client improvements, there will be two big directions where we will be improving. The first being a redesign of Adventure mode, with our new technology and lessons learnt from the 1.0 version, we have been laying the groundworks to create a fun, progressive and at the same time challenging journey for players to go on when they head into PVE. Players can expect to see updates to PVE game modes and content soon around Q2 -3 of this year.

Dueling Mode Enhancements and Content
We are also aiming to enrich the experience of Dueling mode by adding in different features, card types as well as new champions. There will be a range of content scheduled for the coming months as well as close balancing updates that follows the meta. As an example for what we are eager to implement, is raid battles being part of dueling and events that any player can participate in. 

Our love for game development is going strong. We hope all of you that have been with us since the beginning and those who have just started their journey in the arena will have as much fun as we are in the adventure called Death or Glory. 

See you in the Arena!

notes.title: EA 0.1.13 Character Balancing Update
notes.notes:
EA 0.1.13
 

 Patch Highlights 
 Character balancing 
 Deck Edit Crash Fixes 
 Bug Fixes


Balance Changes 
In preparation for the tournament this weekend, we have made a few changes to several characters to balance out the viability of all characters. We aim to create a game where all characters are relevant and maintain competitiveness throughout version updates where new characters will be released. This round of balance changes aims to tweak the power level of certain characters to avoid them becoming overly dominant or overly weak. We didn’t want to do anything too drastic that will change the current strategies and make big shifts to meta now before the tournament. 
 
Tori the Paladin 
Tori receives the most love in this balance patch. Being an Evangelist, she is limited by her indulgence level that essentially limits the number of cards played a turn to 2. Which from play data and feedback from the community, is quite easy to play around in PVP making her difficult to fare against other champions. The changes below aim to address the problems in her play pattern by introducing a new Boon mechanic and increase the consistency of some key cards in her deck. 
 
Boon - New Mechanic 
“When this card is played, it is unaffected by the Evangelist's indulgence level that could result in reducing your devotion or exhaustion.”
 
The main idea of this mechanic is to allow Evangelists to have additional opportunities to play cards before transcendence, thus decreasing their predictability. We will be looking more closely at the class rules and how we can incorporate more Boon cards in the future to increase the number of viable strategies in the class. 
 
Chasten 
Text Change : This is a BOON card and you are granted a Blessing. If your Devotion is 6 or above, your damage is increased by 2. This attack can Interrupt spell casting. 
 
Chasten X
Text Change : This is a Boon card and you are granted a Blessing. If your Devotion is 6 or above, Heal 5 lives. 
 
Repent

notes.title: Enter the King of Monters! Enryu - Character Release!
notes.notes:
EA 0.1.12 
 
Patch Highlights

 Enryu the Gargantusaur character release 
 Performance Optimisation (roughly 45% reduction in VRAM usage) 
 Windy Balance Change 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/8992090d6be651fe98ea4ee1764a4f912f03b876.jpg
Enryu, the Gargantusaur 
The Gargantusaur is not a natural species unlike other dinosaurs that roam the land. When the arena started to fall out of favour, the kingpin that owned the business cross-bred enhanced native Tyrannosauruses into an unstoppable titan. Having the current champions fight such a monster would surely make an incredible spectacle, drawing a massive crowd. But can a beast not born of nature be ever contained?

Dominate the arena as the alpha predator of Corrum! Born as a weapon from a cruel experiment, the Gargantusaur was created as a representation of power. The gigantic monster has scales tough as armour, claws sharp as teeth and the ability to disintegrate anything with a nuclear breath. Join the fight as the King of Monsters and show your foes what it means to be the epitome of evolution! 
*Founders and Early Access Pass owners will automatically unlock Enryu, the Gargantusaur as a playable character in both multiplayer and adventure mode. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/dd3e45975cc8ffae6b5f55ce89e782e66ae20c8f.png

Performance Optimisation 
Since our launch in October, the most major complaint regarding the game was the excessive memory usage that clogged the VRAM of most devices causing crashes to the game and on rare occasions the device itself. We apologize for our oversight and any bad experiences we have caused to our players. For the past few months, we have been digging deep into our base code structure and asset management throughout the game to decrease the memory requirement that exceed what would be deemed reasonable. In this patch we want to launch the first large refactoring of our core structure to improve performance. From our studio testing, we have found our new implementations can reduce roughly 45% of VRAM usage for both default and enhanced graphics mode. We are still in the process of replacing some assets that lost some picture quality and pixel density, but we felt we wanted to push this performance change this update as the first step to our battle. We hope any players who have before avoided the enhanced graphics mode or experienced any performance crashes to now have a new experience with Death or Glory. Please let us know your experience after the patch as we continue moving forward with our performance patching and once again thank you for the great support and sticking with us despite our flaws. 
 
A great big thank you from Distilled Gaming.

Balance Change 

Windy
The design of windy is to create a sense of urgency and inevitability. When windy stacks, less attack options become avaliable for the opposition`. However the current implementation of windy can make the inevitable come within 2 or even 1 turn due to specific card ordering and initial draws. We’ve decided to change windy to only be stackable once per turn to smoothen out the play experience. This will retain the ability to stack more than 1 value of windy per turn but only once, therefore by playing powerful cards Windy can still be gained more rapidly, but not by playing small cards repeatedly in a single turn. 

Added effect : Windy value can only be increased once per turn. (The buff icon will turn grey when it has already been stacked during this turn)


Bug Fixes 

 Codes can now be properly copy and pasted from clipboard.
 An issue with A.T.A.C.R character unlock pop up have been solved. 
 Mystic Well text alignment.
 Fear now interacts with counters correctly.
 Fixed a bug in the visible character deck when playing multiplayer after adventure 
 Fixed an error that caused the death count in the adventure results to display incorrectly

Patch Highlights 

 Card balancing

 UI improvements and bug fixes 

Card Balancing
 
Class Cards - Techie 
Upon the release of our latest character, Susan the Sniper, we revisited the Techie playstyle and made changes to several cards in two regards. The first aspect was to power up and give a stronger playable identity to System Overdrive and Sentry Canon whilst the second aspect was simplifying a basic techie card, Fusion Pistol. 

System Overdrive
We decreased the heat requirement for System Overdrive to make it more playable due to the enormous drawback of not being able to reload at the end of turn due to exhaustion. 

Heat Requirement : 7 > 6 

Sentry Canon
The stats of the Sentry Canon was reworked in order for it to serve a unique purpose (other than mitigating mystic well chances) when compared to a similar parry in Susan’s arsenal. The Sentry Canon, although slow, can now act as a large deterrent to enemy attacks as well as provide the occasional damage. 

Damage/Block Value : 5  2 
Added new card text : If you have not taken damage this turn, speed is increased by 1. 

Fusion Pistol
As a starting card, we felt the ability and ease of use was too complex for most scenarios. Although sometimes it’s fun to blow up big enemies with a basic card, more often than not, we found ourselves unable to play the card due to the complex heat/ammo management that is required to just play it. 

Damage : 5  6 

Targeting Drone

Damage : 4 > 2 

Matter Decoherence
Name Change : Decoherence 

Matter Decoherence X

Silent Shot X 
Damage : 7  3 

Redeye the Werewolf - Eviscerate X 
A card that we’ve always wanted to shine a bit more is Eviscerate X, with its signature high Bleeding output and cool alternate art, it's always a delight to see and admire when it is in hand. Though that's not really the case when we want to be competitive, a 2X bleeding isn’t really too viable against high boss health and the RNG of bleeding. Thus we decided to directly buff this card and give Redeye a new tool to crank out damage. 

Text Change : Apply Bleeding(2X) < (3X)

Tori the Paladin - Bravery X
This card has been on our radar for a while due to its interaction with blessing and application of Fortify and Regen that can practically make Tori an unstoppable tank. But upon further testing stat analysis, we seem to have been too harsh on its condition and powerful so we simplified it and gave it a slight power buff.

A.T.A.C.R - BFM and BFM X 
A big …. Missile is what defines the A.T.A.C.R and its damage certainly is in a class of its own. We believe this card to currently be rather balanced as there is a large risk reward into playing it since it is a missile, there are generally many ways to destroy it. However facing a turn 1 BFM along with a bad starting hand makes for a very bad day as that battle is almost immediately lost. We decided to rebalance the card to avoid this extreme case whilst giving it slightly more power to compensate.

EA 0.1.6
 
General Fixes 

 Roxxor Tree Whack image display error is now fixed in the Deck Edit

Balance Changes  

Persistence 
The fear mechanic has always been a touchy subject throughout the beta and this early period of the EA. Given its RNG nature, it is always a surprise (albeit sometimes a very bad one) whether your strategy can work or will even play out when you are feared. We decided to add Fear into the list of status preventions that Persistence will give to players to allow for more control and counterplay when up against certain enemies that use this mechanic often.  

Added effect: Persistence will now prevent fear from being applied as well as remove existing fear value when played. 

Roxxor - Monkey Hurl 
This card was a little weak in comparison to Roxxor’s other attacks as it is a throw that requires a set up and costs 2 momentum just to do 9 damage. notes.title: Early Access Ver 0.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Patch Highlights 

 Lee upper and lower strike balancing 
 Adventure mode balancing 
 Optimisation improvements 
 Bug fixes 


Balancing 

Lee the Dragon Master 
In the last update we adjusted the reaction cards of the dragon master by reducing the action cost thus levitating the opportunity cost of blocking. This update we will adjust the upper and lower strike package to fit in line with other characters. The problem with the existing mechanics is in order for Lee to activate card texts, his strikes must first be successful AND have a corresponding strike in play first. This results in a large restriction to Lee’s play style as every strike that is played becomes premium. We envisioned Lee to be a flexible jack of all trades warrior that can adapt to situations and pull out the correct tools at the right time. We adjusted a number of his strikes to have an effect on success and be boosted when the upper and lower conditions are met, opening up different patterns of play to make way for the dragon age. 

Knee Kick 
New text : Draw a card. If there is an upper strike in play, draw 2 cards instead.

Knee Kick X
New text : Draw a card. If there is an upper strike in play, draw 2 cards instead and increase your action points by 2. 

Eye Poke 
New text : Apply Daze(1) to your opponent. If there is a lower strike in play, apply Daze(2) instead. 

Eye Poke X
New text : Apply Daze(1) to your opponent. If there is a lower strike in play, apply Daze(2) instead and you are granted Stealth.

Patch Highlights 

 Balancing for Lee, A.T.A.C.R, Crystal and Redeye 
 Performance optimization
 General UI improvements
 Bug fixes 


Card Balancing

Lee - The Dragon Master 
Lee is a master of the dragon arts, with a unique fighting style that emphasizes his flexibility in combat with many tools and mechanics in his arsenal. However it is apparent that in multiplayer, although he has many tools, Lee is often struggling to balance between using his Action Points to attack, or defend. This causes a string of inconsistencies and underwhelming gameplay as the power of his upper and lower strikes come from playing consecutive attacks but he is unable to do that if he has no remaining actions due to blocking. We have adjusted the cost of 3 reaction cards in his deck to make him more versatile and agile towards his other fellow champions.

Speed Value : 2  The damage of your next attack this turn is increased by 4 and its speed is increased by 1


A.T.A.C.R All Terrain Armored Combat Robot
From the data and feedback received from the first week of launch, it is evident that our cute and destructive robot needs a cooldown. With explosive firepower and a consistent tempo, it can often be hard to counter or comeback from a fight against an A.T.A.C.R that had a good opening hand. We toned down the long lasting effects of Crippling Volley and lowered the attack damage of B.F.M as the first step. We will continue to be on the lookout for our metal friend and further balancing may come in future balance patches. 

Crippling Volley 
Text Change : The speed of your opponents attacks is decreased by 1 for the rest of the game > The speed of your opponents attacks is decreased by 1 until the end of turn. 

Crippling Volley X
Text Change : The speed of your opponents attacks is decreased by 1 for the rest of the game > The speed of your opponents attacks is decreased by 1 until the end of turn. 

B.F.M 
Attack damage : 27 > 24 

B.F.M X 
Attack damage : 27 > 24 


Crystal the Ice Faerie 
Frozen is a core mechanic of Crystal and acts as an important piece to her puzzle for her survivability and set up. Without frozen, Crystal would take too long to set up and her power cannot compete in a game between opponents of equal health. However we recognise the frustration and hopelessness when up against her, especially if her game plan is to slowly and consistently lock you down. This pacing and continued lock is not what her playstyle intends to promote therefore we adjusted the mana cost of her most reliable Frozen card to reduce the viability of locking down your opponent for multiple turns in the early game.

notes.title: Death Or Glory Unleashed: 1st Major Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/ac079e251f6278fad762f2cf6cd4df2b616782ca.png
[hr][/hr]
Greetings, Champions! 👊

Drumroll please, because...

Battles in Death or Glory are getting a "facelift" with new and dynamic user interfaces that capture the depth of our Asymmetric Combat System! Every class in the game has gone through a visual redesign to bring to you an immersive experience and a fresh take on the genre. This is our biggest update yet! 

We will be updating each class periodically leading up to our Early Access launch in 2023. The Monster players are the lucky ones this time! Enjoy this whole new experience as you unleash your inner beast in the Arena! 

✨ What’s New? 

 New Monster Combat UI 
 Dynamic Monster Resource interactions 
 Two uniquely designed Bonus Cards for Redeye 
 New combat flow and visual design overhaul 
 Exciting card art highlights
 Fresh character introduction matches
 2 new Arena Paths 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/b790f75221c5b6643166d734ffb04e5cc4906f0b.gif
New Monster UI + Redeye card art animations!
[hr][/hr]
🃏 NEW CARDS 

Redeye is the first character to get this dynamic upgrade and we got 2 brand-new cards to go with it, for more synergy and explosive power! 

Play Silent Stalking preemptively to easily build up your bloodlust, its incredible speed will give your opponent a hard time trying to react. Wounded Predator is Redeye’s most powerful base damage card that will be sure to break through defenses and heavily wound your prey. Both cards synergize well with the existing deck to create exciting combos and situations that will bring you even closer to the ultimate Glory! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/a600ad78c16deb03a58d9e1760fecbff8e9ea2a7.gif
New Monster UI + Emberfist card art animations!
[hr][/hr]
⚔️ NEW ARENA 

We made changes to the structure of the Arena Game Mode so players can earn rewards as they complete new arenas. There will now be different themes for each dungeon and we will continue to add more interesting rules and challenges, look forward to them in each update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/10a85ed023ee5d1a54577a2e716053a16f26f075.gif
New Monster UI + Hatranos card art animations!
[hr][/hr]
🎨 NEW ART AND GRAPHICS 

The combat experience of Death or Glory is getting a massive upgrade as we are now customizing every UI design to fit each class archetype. Monsters will have large gashes of claws and raging fire then they unleash, dynamically responding to how you play the game. 
The card play experience is also enhanced as we have now implemented new sequences that highlight the stunning card art in play. These new changes are sure to create new memories and moments in your journey to Glory!

💛 Make Sure To Join Our Discord Arena

Join our community of champions over our Discord server to discuss strategies, brag about your wins, and stay on top of the latest Death or Glory news!


Catch you in the Arena!
